history.title: Keep it. Find it again.
history.body: Keep text, images and files in your clipboard history, ready to find when you need them.

sync.title: Bring your devices together
sync.body: Connect your phone and computer to send text, images and files between your own devices.

settings.title: Make yourself at home
settings.body: Start using local features now. When you need sync, choose a sync method and connect your devices in Settings.

setup.title: Start syncing
setup.body: Create a new encrypted space or join an existing one with an invitation.

result.title: Your space is ready
result.body: This device can now sync your clipboard securely through the space.

welcome.title:
Your clipboard,
on every device
welcome.body: All your own devices sharing one clipboard — no collaboration, no cloud.

companion.title:
A companion
to your computer
companion.body: Connect to the UniClipboard desktop app that's already running, and bring your clipboard to hand.

action.title: Copy here, paste there
action.body: Copy on your computer and paste on your phone; use the share sheet to send anything back.
